sn45.57-61:1.1: suriyassa bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ aruṇaggaṃ. evameva kho bhikkhave, bhikkhuno ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimmittaṃ, yadidaṃ sīlasampadā. sīlasampannassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ …pe… bahulīkarotīti. (vitthāretabbaṃ) 1. 6. 10. dutiya chandasuttaṃ suriyassa bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅgamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ aruṇaggaṃ.
